_doc: Enforcement-coverage baseline. `blocking` counts rules whose strongest enforced_by resolves to something that can fail a build. `frequency_gap` counts rules whose carrier does not fire often enough to cover their declared obligation on some hook-capable platform — a rule can be blocking and in that bucket at once. Coverage is a ratchet: --check fails when blocking falls, or unwired / local_only / missing / frequency_gap rises. Regenerate intentionally with --write-baseline when the change is the point.
